messages.content:
You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many kilometers did Tom travel during his two-week-long trip? Tom's trip through Europe lasted two weeks. During the first four days of the trip, Tom traveled 200 kilometers every day. During the next two days after the first four days, Tom traveled a total distance equal to 30% of the distance traveled during the first four days. On the day after those two days, Tom did not travel. During the second week of the trip, Tom traveled 300 kilometers every day. Tom paid 0.50 dollars per kilometer for transportation throughout the first week. Transportation costs were charged only for kilometers traveled.
